findings.rationale: World-open ingress on an administrative shell port puts an interactive login surface on every routable address; credential attacks need no application flaw.
The database engine port is reachable from any address; the only remaining barriers are the engine's own authentication and patch level.

findings.control: defense-in-depth: public access block neutralizes an anonymous grant
findings.rationale: The bucket policy would grant anonymous reads, but all four Block Public Access toggles are on, so the grant never takes effect: a contained misconfiguration to report at low severity, not a live exposure.
